events.purpose: Reach the eastern pushing stance of M0.
M0 delivers the player beside M1; D contacts M1 while U/R are blocked.
M1 delivers the player beside M2; R is the only legal next input in this state.
M2 arrives in a clear area that permits changing pushing sides.
Move M2 downward to prepare its westbound reuse.
The westbound push reaches a stance with access to the bottom corridor.
Leave M2 parked and reach the complete bottom doorway.
